note: Pictures that ship with the site (public/images/<id>.webp, made by npm run images from images/<id>.*) for questions that already live in the database. Each time the server sees this file change, it attaches every picture listed here to its question if that question has no picture yet, and keeps the description and credit of pictures it attached in step with this file. A picture uploaded in the builder is never replaced.
